goal: Prevent orphan transactions from getting stuck when their non-witness parent is announced by a different peer
Ensure nodes still query child announcers for low-feerate legacy parents during opportunistic 1P1C relay
reviewability: May be folded into #36437 or rebased after it lands
agreement: Verified by testing on Windows x86_64 (Yudis-bit)
Suggested tackling these orphan cases together in #36437 rather than piecemeal (instagibbs)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it fixes an orphan relay stall specific to non-witness parents arriving from separate peers
Affects opportunistic 1P1C transaction download liveness for legacy transactions
